Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National | Regional One person dead, five military personnel injured as Circle demolition turns violent – Regional Minister Source : Adomonline 25 November 2026 3:20pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Greater Accra Regional Minister Linda Obenewaa Akweley Ocloo has confirmed that one person has died after a clash between military personnel and some individuals during a demolition exercise at Kwame Nkrumah Circle in Accra.
The incident happened along the railway line from Circle towards Agbogbloshie, where structures are being pulled down.
Speaking to the media, Madam Ocloo, who is also the Member of Parliament for Shai-Osudoku, said five soldiers were injured and are receiving treatment at the 37 Military Hospital. She said she could not immediately establish the circumstances of the death.
According to her, the demolition follows a fire along the railway corridor about a week ago. The area has had similar fires in the past, and authorities have moved to secure it and stop further redevelopment.
She said residents and occupants were engaged before the exercise, a committee was set up to facilitate discussions, and the occupants were informed of the planned demolition.
Authorities returned to the area, she explained, to protect lives and secure the railway corridor, but the operation turned violent after soldiers were attacked.
While thanking the security officers who took part, the Minister condemned the violence and warned that anyone who returns to occupy or build on the railway corridor will be prosecuted.
She stressed that the government will not tolerate reoccupation of the demolished railway lands and urged residents and others to comply with the authorities’ directives.
